convert_slow_checkpoint_to_fast: convert a slow tokenizer checkpoint to fast serialization format using the convert_slow_checkpoint_to_fast function
build_all_tokenizer_conversions: build all slow tokenizer to fast tokenizer conversions by calling convert_slow_checkpoint_to_fast without specifying a tokenizer name
run_single_tokenizer_conversion: run a single tokenizer conversion by specifying the tokenizer name and checkpoint name arguments
force_download_tokenizer: force re-download and convert a tokenizer checkpoint by passing the force_download flag
convert_specific_checkpoint: convert a specific checkpoint for a given tokenizer by providing the tokenizer name and checkpoint name
